status: REVIEW ONLY — no loot/config/code replacements applied
configuration: No active hbmItemPools.json override. Pack underscore template matches tested defaults. Editing _hbmItemPools.json alone has no effect. Active hbmItemPools.json replaces the entire pool map, so later installation must preserve all 51 pools.
scope: All 51 initialized NTM ItemPool definitions; all 31 affected pools. Source usages include non-structure drops. Separate vanilla ChestGenHooks and direct/decorative grants are noted in the report; no claim all loot routes are covered by these 51 pools. AE2 loot tables are unchanged.
math: Lost weight is per-draw selection probability. q^8 is exact probability of no nonzero output in eight independent draws, not a guarantee for real inventories. 27-slot simulation includes zero counts, stack splitting and slot overwrites; actual containers, counts and multi-pool mixtures differ. These are projections, not full progression balance proof.
